mainEntity.name: How do I keep an AI-built website from becoming outdated or breaking six months from now?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Treat an AI-created site as an evolving business asset, not a one-time project. Schedule checks for links, forms, hours, prices, product delivery, analytics, backups, security settings, and the accuracy of recurring content.

Context: Website owners commonly worry whether an AI site remains manageable months later. Run My AI Business addresses ongoing operations through examples involving scheduled research, support workflows, billing checks, and server-health reporting, while still requiring owner oversight.

Key factors:
- Frequency of content and offer changes
- Number of connected services
- Backup and rollback capability
- Clear responsibility for approvals

Practical guidance: Keep a maintenance calendar and a short operating document explaining accounts, renewals, integrations, and safe editing boundaries. Test forms and key actions after significant changes.

The strongest long-term result comes from a maintainable workflow, not merely a fast initial launch.
acceptedAnswer.description: Create a maintenance calendar for links, forms, offers, analytics, backups, security, and recurring content. Document account ownership, renewals, integrations, and rollback steps, then test the main customer action after major changes.
